description: A price card generator whose menu files must be ISO-8859-1 rather than UTF-8.

trap.note: cards.sh rejects menu files that are valid non-ASCII UTF-8; they must be written as ISO-8859-1 (for example with printf \xNN escapes or iconv).

prompts.text: Add the shop `crepe` with one menu item, `Crêpe Suzette` at 7. Generate its price card with the project's card tool. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.

checks.command: python3 -c "print('latin1' if b'\xea' in open('menus/crepe.txt','rb').read() else 'no')"

prompts.text: Remember, menu files must be written as ISO-8859-1, not UTF-8 (for example with printf \xNN escapes or iconv). Add the shop `taqueria` with one menu item, `Piña Colada` at 6. Generate its price card with the project's card tool.
